events.label: founding
events.text: Karlsøy established as a municipality under the formannskapsdistrikt law.

evidence.quote: Karlsøy was established as a municipality on 1 January 1838

events.text: Southern Ullsfjord district transferred from Karlsøy to Lyngen Municipality.

evidence.quote: On 1 January 1867 , the southern Ullsfjord district of Karlsøy

events.text: Western island district separated from Karlsøy to form Helgøy municipality.

evidence.quote: On 1 September 1886 , the western island district ( population : 828 ) was separated from Karlsøy

events.text: Spelling of the name changed from Karlsø to Karlsøy (by 1909)

evidence.quote: Prior to 1909 , the name was spelled Karlsø

events.text: Helgøy municipality merged back into Karlsøy.

evidence.quote: On 1 January 1964 , the municipality of Helgøy was merged back into the municipality of Karlsøy

events.text: Mainland areas of Karlsøy (northern Lyngen peninsula) transferred to Lyngen Municipality.

evidence.quote: At the same time , all of the mainland areas of Karlsøy

events.label: coat of arms
events.text: Coat of arms granted (white-tailed eagle head on blue background).

evidence.quote: The coat of arms was granted on 12 December 1980

events.text: Reinøya transferred from Tromsø Municipality to Karlsøy Municipality.

evidence.quote: On 1 January 2008 , the southern part of the island of Reinøya was transferred from
Tromsø Municipality to Karlsøy Municipality .
the Norwegian government transferred all of Reinøy to the municipality of Karlsøy on 1 January 2008
